Print a tuning grid

Source: R/tune.R
print.transitiontrees_tune.Rd

print() prints the number of configurations, the first n rows of the grid (lowest held-out perplexity first) and the selected configuration.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees_tune'
print(x, n = 10L, ...)

Arguments

x

A transitiontrees_tune object.

n

Number of configurations to print. Default 10.

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

tune_tree(), as.data.frame.transitiontrees_tune for the full grid.

Examples

tuned <- tune_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 1:2, min_count = 5,
                   prune = FALSE, folds = 3)
print(tuned, n = 3)
#> <transitiontrees_tune>  2 configurations
#>  max_depth min_count                           smoothing prune    logLik
#>          2         5 floor(ymin=0.001, rule=interpolate) FALSE -1592.852
#>          1         5 floor(ymin=0.001, rule=interpolate) FALSE -1659.904
#>  n_scored perplexity n_nodes_avg folds_failed
#>      1870   2.343845          13            0
#>      1870   2.429412           4            0
#> 
#> best (min perplexity):
#>  max_depth min_count                           smoothing prune    logLik
#>          2         5 floor(ymin=0.001, rule=interpolate) FALSE -1592.852
#>  n_scored perplexity n_nodes_avg folds_failed
#>      1870   2.343845          13            0
